name: Al-Maidah
description: QR digital menu, kitchen ticket board, and owner panel for restaurants in the United Arab Emirates.
description_good_justification: README describes the product, problem, and MVP surfaces: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: README links to install, contributing, support, security, and issues: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/blob/main/README.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Coding standards, CI expectations, and review rules: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_interface_justification: Product surfaces and routes are documented in the README: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/blob/main/README.md
sites_https_justification: GitHub repository and docs use HTTPS.
english_justification: Project documentation and issue templates are in English.
maintained_justification: Active commits and an open MVP issue roadmap: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/issues/1
repo_track_justification: git on GitHub tracks author, change, and time.
repo_interim_justification: Development happens on the public main branch with interim commits.
version_unique_justification: Semantic versions are recorded in CHANGELOG.md; tags will follow releases.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning is declared in CHANGELOG.md.
version_tags_justification: Releases will use git tags matching CHANGELOG versions.
report_responses_justification: Project is newly public; maintainers monitor GitHub issues.
enhancement_responses_justification: Feature requests use the feature template and MVP parent issue #1.
test_justification: Automated tests via node:test and GitHub Actions CI: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_invocation_justification: `npm test` runs node:test suites under test/.
test_most_justification: Current repository functionality is covered by unit tests for the published JavaScript module and CI repository-health checks. Application coverage expands with MVP-01.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING requires CI green and tests for new code before merge.
build_justification: `npm run lint` syntax-checks JavaScript sources. The full Nuxt build arrives with MVP-01.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL on push and pull requests: https://github.com/ale94lko/al-maidah/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Findings are expected to be fixed or dismissed before merge.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Dynamic analysis will be added once runtime services exist.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No unsafe memory language in the planned TypeScript stack.
crypto_software_justification: No custom cryptography; TLS and payment crypto are provided by platforms (GitHub HTTPS, Stripe).
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only over HTTPS via GitHub.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Source is obtained from the GitHub repository over HTTPS.
know_secure_design_justification: SECURITY.md and architecture notes cover multi-tenant isolation, server-side payments, and secret handling.
know_common_errors_justification: Contributing and security docs call out secret leakage and unvalidated client totals.
https_redirect_justification: GitHub enforces HTTPS for the project sites.
hardening_justification: Scorecard, CodeQL, Dependabot, branch ruleset, and least-privilege workflow permissions.
